Select IC50 activity records for dapagliflozin and its salt forms against sodium/glucose cotransporter 1. Define the compound set from parent dapagliflozin (CHEMBL429910) via molecule_hierarchy. Join through the FAQ provenance path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Include compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target CHEMBL4979 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Preserve row multiplicity; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
